rachel: FYI i opened a small change to the SDKs to optionally emit a compact quota hint so client libs can help surface "estimated units" in apps. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/1703

diego: can you clarify semantics quickly? will this affect billing or server quotas?

rachel: advisory only. header name is `X-RW-Quota-Hint: v1;units=2;score=0.8`. `units` is integer estimate, `score` is confidence 0..1. ingestion will record `client_units` and `client_confidence`. no change to server-side enforcement.

mohit: platform concern: dashboards must not double-count. ingestion should store both `units_server` and `units_client_hint` separately and aggregation logic must use server as canonical. any overlays must be opt-in.

clare: UX note: product wants a simple chart showing "Server units" with a faint dotted overlay "Client-estimated" when toggled. Also an adoption card showing percent of requests with hint. keep overlay off by default.

diego: ops asks for a rollout path. don't bake canary % into SDKs. do server-side canary assignment and ingest will tag events with `client_hint_canary` for analysis. SDK only marks intent with header.

rachel: SDK will default to not sending header. opt-in via constructor param: `new RedwoodClient({ quotaHint: { enabled: true, sample: 0.05 } })`. no breaking change.

mohit: ingestion mechanics: add `client_units:int` nullable, `client_conf:float`, and `hint_schema_version:string`. index `units.client_est` in the route store. add ability to run a backfill that sets `client_units=1` for missing hints for a configurable window, but only when org feature-flag `client_quota_backfill` = true. backlog note: audit trail required for backfilled events.

clare: tooltip copy suggestion: "Client-provided estimates are advisory. Server-side quota enforcement is authoritative. Use the overlay to compare estimates." i'll add copy.

diego: one more: telemetry team wants a metric `hint_adoption_rate` per route. ingestion should emit a daily rollup. also include `hint_confidence_avg` to monitor quality.

rachel: added a tiny logger in SDK: `logger.debug('quota-hint sent', { units, score })`. added unit + integration test that hits local ingest proxy.

mohit: please ensure SDKs behind serverless bundlers default OFF so we don't accidentally enable via serialized config. add a README callout.

clare: dashboard plan: phase1 add overlay toggle + adoption card; phase2 show confidence heatmap for routes with >5% adoption. keep overlay off by default and show a beta ribbon while adoption < 20%.

diego: rollout schedule: ship SDK minor tomorrow, ingestion schema + index next week, dashboard overlay following week. backfill remains OFF by default; ops will flip per-org if requested. do a 3% canary for 10 days for initial telemetry collection.

mohit: ingestion PR will include audit events for any backfill (`audit.event='client_quota_backfill'`). also we need a migration guide for downstream consumers so queries explicitly pick `units.server` vs `units.client_est`.

rachel: docs: i'll add a short changelog entry: "Opt-in client quota hints (advisory only). No change to server-side quotas." and a small FAQ section.

deploy-bot: CI: PR 1703 queued. unit tests passed. integration flaky test retried and succeeded.

clare: i'll open the dashboard PR after ingestion mapping is merged. tagging: @mohit (ingest mapping + audit), @diego (ops canary list), @clare (dashboard UI), @rachel (SDK changelog).

rachel: thanks all, will merge once CI green and will tag for the canary list. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR 1703 merged into main.
